Internal commands, not shell commands. For selected folders, agent mask, subfolder, depth and file-count settings apply. glob finds paths (* within a component, ? one character, ** across folders). grep finds content: -F literal (default), -E PCRE regex, -i ignore case, -s match case, -v invert, -w whole words; -n is accepted and line numbers are always shown. --glob filters paths. --limit 1..10000 limits all results (default 200). --bookmarks searches only bookmarked lines of the open file. --mark adds bookmarks to its matching lines; other-file hits are skipped. Bookmark commands require indexed reading. Quotes preserve spaces and backslashes; -- ends options. Plain text keeps the existing search. Results are paginated; Open navigates, Copy copies the retained results. Partial/cancelled results are not totals. Examples below use sample English content; replace the quoted search text as needed.
Read/index the open file before using bookmark commands.

GB files are streamed in blocks; no full-file buffer. Lines are limited to 16,777,216 decoded characters with an explicit error. At the hit cap, scanning stops and results are partial, not exact totals.

What the AI can generate, which languages are validated, how to fix errors with the AI and where each feature is.
Copy this whole help as text.

Automatic fix after a failed validation|Click "Fix with AI": the AI receives the file and the errors, the corrected file is saved over it (FastFile asks first if it is outside the fastfile_assistant folder) and it is validated again.|
Change the last generated file|Ask for changes in the question box; the AI rewrites the last generated file.|fix the generated file: add error handling
C# (.cs)|Classes, records, interfaces and services.|create a C# class BankAccount with Deposit and Withdraw methods

SQL, JSON, HTML, Markdown, TXT|Scripts, configuration files, pages and texts. Write the extension (.sql, .json, .html, .md, .txt) in the request.|generate a .sql script that creates the customers table with id, name and e-mail
Documents: PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF (Word)|Summaries and reports, also from the open file.|summarize the open file in PDF
Go (.go)|Packages, structs and functions.|write a Go program (.go) that counts the lines of a text file
Java (.java)|Classes, interfaces and enums. One public class per file, with the same name as the file.|create a Java class Product with name and price, getters and setters
JavaScript (.js)|Classes, functions and Node.js scripts. Say "JavaScript" or ".js".|create a JavaScript function that validates an e-mail address
C / C++, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift|Generated the same way (.cpp, .c, .rs, .php, .rb, .kt, .swift), but not validated yet.|write a C++ function that reverses a string
Delphi / Pascal (.pas, .dpr, .inc)|Units, classes, procedures and functions.|create a Delphi unit with a function that formats a phone number

Python (.py)|Scripts, classes and functions. To transform the lines of the open file, use the Python macro (Ctrl+Alt+E) instead.|generate a Python script that reads a CSV file and sums the value column
React (.tsx) and JSX (.jsx)|Components and hooks. "React" produces .tsx; ask for ".jsx" for plain JavaScript.|generate a React component for a to-do list in TSX
TypeScript / Angular (.ts)|Interfaces, types, classes and services. Say "TypeScript", "Angular" or ".ts".|create a TypeScript interface Customer and a class CustomerService with add and find methods

The AI Assistant (Ctrl+Alt+A) writes a complete source file from your request and saves it in the fastfile_assistant folder. Then it can check the syntax and, if there are errors, fix the file with the AI. Double-click an example to put it in the question box.
Running and building|The code is never run and FastFile does not build projects (no package.json, tsconfig, Maven, npm install, tests or formatting). It creates one file per request.|
Languages without validation|C / C++, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift and Delphi / Pascal are generated but not validated yet.|
One file at a time|Java and C# are checked alone, so references to other classes of your project can show up as errors. JSON / HTML / SQL checks are structural only.|
Validate (syntax only; the code is never run)
Python / JavaScript / TypeScript|ScriptEngine.exe and CodeCheck.exe are downloaded automatically on first use (internet needed once). Without them FastFile says so and does not validate.|
JSON / HTML / SQL|Built into FastFile: always available, no external program.|
Source code with AI: generate, validate and fix
Put the selected example in the question box (then click Send).
C# (.cs)|Uses csc.exe from Visual Studio / Build Tools (modern C#) or, failing that, the one in the Windows .NET Framework (C# 5 only). Without csc.exe, FastFile says so and does not validate.|
Go (.go)|Uses gofmt from the Go installation (PATH, GOROOT or C:\Program Files\Go). Syntax only. Without Go, FastFile says so and does not validate.|

How to validate|Use the validate button on the card of the generated file, or ask in the question box with the full path. Without a path, a window opens to pick the file.|validate the syntax of C:\temp\script.py

Java (.java)|Uses javac from the JDK installed on this PC (PATH, JAVA_HOME or the usual folders). It compiles into a temporary folder, so type errors are reported too. Without a JDK, FastFile says so and does not validate.|
JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, TSX / React|Files .js, .mjs, .cjs, .jsx, .ts and .tsx, checked by CodeCheck.exe (downloaded automatically on first use).|validate the syntax of C:\projects\app\src\api.ts

JSON, HTML, SQL (.json, .html, .htm, .sql)|Checked by FastFile itself, no extra program: full JSON syntax; HTML tags opened and closed; SQL quotes, comments, parentheses and BEGIN/CASE...END blocks.|validate the syntax of C:\data\config.json
Python (.py)|Checked by ScriptEngine.exe, downloaded automatically on first use.|

AI agent|Ask the agent as usual: it hands generating, validating and fixing source files to the Assistant, and the result appears below the agent's answer (nothing to accept).|validate the syntax of C:\projects\app\src\App.tsx

AI Assistant (Ctrl+Alt+A)|Type the request in the question box and click Send. The file is saved in the fastfile_assistant folder (or in the path you give) and a green card offers to open it, show the folder and validate it.|create a JavaScript class Person with name, age and a toString method

Buttons and links|The </> button (next to ? in the Assistant) and "Source code..." in "What can I do?" open this help. After a failed validation the panel offers "Fix with AI" and "</> Code: learn more".|

RECENT UPDATES (v3.0.5.255 – v3.0.5.261)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  The interface now has 22 languages, including Hindi, Russian, Korean,
    Dutch, Turkish and Ukrainian. Hindi uses a left-to-right layout.
  Equal-parts processing reads memory-mapped chunks without loading
    the whole file; the split tab stays open when it finishes.
  After reading a file, the next-steps guide suggests useful actions.
    Reopen it in Preferences or turn it off there.
  The editing context menu and session-history wording were localized.
  The guide and Preferences were redesigned; the guide initializes
    without flicker or interrupting file reading.
